readmission.name: 30-day readmission
readmission.cohort: UCI Diabetes 130-US Hospitals 1999–2008: inpatient stays of patients with diabetes. First discharge per patient, excluding discharge to hospice or death, then a stratified random sample of 20,000 (random_state=0).
readmission.job: Predict readmission within 30 days, at discharge.
readmission.framing: Results apply to this historical inpatient cohort involving diabetes, not to all discharges.
readmission.source: UCI Machine Learning Repository: Diabetes 130-US Hospitals for Years 1999–2008
readmission.citation: Strack B, DeShazo JP, Gennings C, et al. Impact of HbA1c measurement on hospital readmission rates: analysis of 70,000 clinical database patient records. BioMed Research International 2014;2014:781670.

diabetes.name: Diabetes screening
diabetes.cohort: NHANES 2017–2018: adults (18+) with an HbA1c measurement who answered “Has a doctor ever told you that you have diabetes?” with yes, no or borderline.
diabetes.job: Flag adults for follow-up testing; finding positives matters most.
diabetes.teaches: Choosing a threshold for a sensitivity target
diabetes.framing: The label is “reported doctor diagnosis or HbA1c ≥ 6.5%”. It includes adults who were already diagnosed. It identifies the label at one time point and does not predict future diabetes. Results describe adults in this sample.
diabetes.prediction_point: At the survey examination, before the blood test results
diabetes.source: CDC/NCHS National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) 2017–2018, public-use files
diabetes.citation: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, National Center for Health Statistics. National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey 2017–2018.
